name: nature_full_subsectioned
nature_variant: abstract first; methods LAST (Nature house style, opposite of many journals); Results carries one titled subsection per figure/theme (e.g. QD synthesis, film characterization, device performance); Methods split into titled subsections (Materials; Device fabrication; Characterization)
note: QLED/PeLED/micro-LED full-length paper: results subsectioned by measurement chain (materials -> characterization -> device metrics -> mechanism)

name: nature_full_methods_subsectioned
nature_variant: abstract first; methods last; Results flows as undivided prose; Methods still split into Materials / Device fabrication / Characterization subsections
note: variant of Nature Communications standard for shorter device papers with few figures

name: nature_full_plain
nature_variant: abstract first; methods last; both Results and Methods are undivided running text (no subsection headers)
note: concise full structure: abstract->intro->results->discussion->methods with discussion summarizing device metrics and mechanism attribution

name: nature_comms_discussion_in_results
nature_variant: abstract first; methods last; no separate Discussion header; the closing Results subsection (often device comparison / stability) carries the discussion function
note: Nature Communications layout where discussion is folded into Results; typical ending subsections: device performance comparison table, operational stability, mechanism summary

name: lsa_summary_discussion
nature_variant: abstract first; NO separate Methods section (experimental details in Supplementary Information); Discussion is a single summary-style closing section
note: Light: Science & Applications (LSA) layout: abstract->intro->results->discussion, methods in supplementary; Discussion opens "In summary, we have developed..." recapping EQE/luminance/CIE and the passivation or device strategy
